rows.text: finds the node whose dword `+0x20` equals `edx` (lower-bound walk from qword `rcx+0xc8`, header `rcx+0xb8`, following qword `+8` when the node's key is not below `edx` and qword `+0` otherwise, signed); when found it decrements dword `+0x48` of the node's qword `+0x28` and, when that reaches 0, calls slot `+0x10` of the vtable of the object at `rcx+0x1b8` with (`rcx+0x1b8`, `0x18`, 0), writes dwords `edx` and 4 at the returned block's `+0x10`/`+0x14` and links the block in last on the list headed at `rcx+0x1a8` (block `+0` = `rcx+0x1a8`, block `+8` = qword `rcx+0x1b0`, then that node's qword `+0` and qword `rcx+0x1b0` = the block); when `edx` is not negative it then does the same for the key `-2 - edx`

with `n` = dword `rcx+0x5c` and `d` the fifth (stack) argument (float), takes `s0` = trunc((1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) - `xmm1`) * `n`), `s1` = trunc(`n` * `xmm2`), `s2` = trunc(`n` * `d`) and `v` = `xmm3` * 100.0 (`008F3134`) * `d`, and stores `xmm3` * 127.0 (`00906A44`) at floats `+0x50`, `+0x54` and `+0x58`; for each `i` below `n` it writes the float at `rcx` + `i`*0x10 + `0x6c`: 0 when `i` <= `s0`, else `v` when `i` <= `s1`, else `v` * (`D` - (`i` - `s1`)) / `D` with `D` = `s2` - `s1` when `i` <= `s2`, else 0 (all compares unsigned); then zeroes the dword at `rcx` + (`n`-1)*0x10 + `0x6c`, calls `003F6A10` + 0x109(the sixth (stack) argument, `rcx` + (`s0`+6)*0x10) and stores the bit pattern `0x3f800000` at dword `+0xc` of the sixth argument
